**Chinese name:** 飞腾信息技术有限公司 (Fēiténg Xìnxī Jìshù Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Jointly established in 2014 by China Electronics Corporation (a central state-owned enterprise), the Tianjin Binhai New Area government, and the Tianjin Advanced Technology Research Institute — one of the most directly state-backed design houses in this tracker. Added to the Entity List in April 2021 over supercomputing ties to Chinese military modernization; TSMC subsequently stopped supplying it.
:::

## What does this firm design?

ARM-based CPUs across server, desktop, and embedded product lines, used primarily in government and state-sector systems.
